title: Eric Wargo: remote viewing as precognition

tellings.quote: Eric Wargo argues this in his book time Loops that remote viewing is really just precognition

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a writer named Eric Wargo, who argues in his book Time Loops that remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind, is really precognition, meaning a glimpse of the future. Michels raises it because, if true, it would change how such strange mental experiences, and time itself, should be understood.
